description:
The back bed is the main needle bed on Japanese flat-bed knitting machines.
It’s the workhorse of the machine, handling most of your knitting whether you’re using it on its own or paired with the ribber for double-bed fabrics.
tooltip: Main needle bed on Japanese flat-bed machines; the primary knitting surface.
example: Transfer all ribber stitches back to the Main Bed before starting the shaping.
